---
title: "Blog"
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Blog}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load cfb2nfl from the checkout when the package is not installed, so the
# site build does not require a package install (decision 0030).
if (requireNamespace("cfb2nfl", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # vignettes render in a fresh quarto R session: attach the installed package
  # (CI installs it via local::.) or source the checkout fallback below.
  library(cfb2nfl)
} else {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  for (src in sort(list.files(file.path(dir, "R"), pattern = "[.]R$", full.names = TRUE))) {
    source(src, local = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  }
}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(htmltools)
library(reactable)

# Blog posts are dated vignettes (decision 0015); the table is built from the
# files themselves so a new post appears just by adding YYYY-MM-DD-slug.qmd.
root <- cfb2nfl_root()
post_files <- sort(list.files(file.path(root, "vignettes"),
  pattern = "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-.+\\.qmd$", full.names = TRUE
), decreasing = TRUE)

posts <- map_dfr(post_files, function(f) {
  meta <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(f)
  slug <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  tibble(
    date = meta$date,
    title = meta$title,
    author = paste(meta$author, collapse = ", "),
    href = paste0(slug, ".html")
  )
})
```

```{r}
#| label: table
#| echo: false
reactable(
  posts,
  columns = list(
    date = colDef(name = "Date", width = 110),
    title = colDef(
      name = "Post",
      cell = function(value, index) {
        tags$a(href = posts$href[index], value, class = "fs-5")
      }
    ),
    author = colDef(name = "Author", width = 160),
    href = colDef(show = FALSE)
  ),
  sortable = FALSE,
  pagination = FALSE,
  theme = reactable::reactableTheme(cellPadding = "12px 10px")
)
```
